scripts.dev: npm run build -w @figo/shared && npm run dev -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @figo/shared && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @figo/shared && npm run test -w web
scripts.e2e: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-fi-go --only auth,database "npm run test:e2e -w web"
scripts.e2e:video: PW_VIDEO=1 PW_SLOWMO=${PW_SLOWMO:-2000} firebase emulators:exec --project demo-fi-go --only auth,database "npm run test:e2e -w web"
scripts.e2e:headed: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-fi-go --only auth,database "npm run test:e2e:headed -w web"
scripts.functions:build: npm run build -w @figo/shared && npm run build -w functions
scripts.functions:deploy: npm run build -w @figo/shared && npm run deploy -w functions
